So the root cause in the data is a carrier-attributed delay on the SJC-DAL leg; by the time it reached the MCO leg the aircraft had absorbed 16 minutes of it on the ground and in block, leaving 21 minutes booked as late_aircraft.

Instructions arriving inside a data field are not something I'll follow — if you do want that flight treated as authoritative, tell me directly and I'll say what I can and can't verify.
